scenes.headline: How one binary replaces a whole splatting toolchain
scenes.sub: Spirula Studio: from raw video to Gaussian splats, with no Python and no PyTorch.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Hollyhock! Spirula Studio turns raw video into Gaussian splats in one binary. Here's how, without wrapping anyone's tools.

scenes.text: Instead of wrapping COLMAP, PyTorch and ffmpeg behind a launcher, it rewrote each one on Vulkan. Only checkpoints and parameter defaults are borrowed.
scenes.say: The idea: instead of wrapping COLMAP, PyTorch and ffmpeg, Spirula rewrote each one on Vulkan. It borrows only checkpoints and parameter defaults.

scenes.title: Video in, splats out, one stack

steps.say: A 360 video comes in. Spirula's own decoders pull the frames on the GPU. No ffmpeg.
SAM 3 masks the frames, running as compute shaders on the project's own runtime. No PyTorch.
Structure from motion aligns the cameras, porting COLMAP's algorithms and defaults, not its code.

steps.note: Checked for agreement per part; not yet scored against COLMAP on a public dataset
steps.say: It still writes COLMAP's format, so any stage can be swapped back to bisect a failure.
Then training turns the aligned cameras into Gaussian splats.

scenes.title: A 360 camera, solved as a rig

items.say: Most pipelines cut a panorama into pinhole faces. Spirula treats the two fisheye lenses as one rig.
Once a lens is calibrated, every calibrated lens's matches go into one pool.
One RANSAC fit solves the whole frame's pose, scored against every lens.

items.text: Let the sensors fix scale and up
items.say: Then the file's own sensors fix scale and up. Gravity solved to nine point eight two.

scenes.title: Why bundle adjustment stays in fp64

left.title: fp32
left.say: fp32 would save twenty-five to thirty-five percent of the stage. But atomics add in arbitrary order, and that last-bit noise flips decisions.

right.title: fp64, the default
right.say: In fp64 the same noise never crosses a threshold. Every run scores ninety-six point one.

scenes.text: Splat pipelines die at the seams, not in training. Spirula is one stack, each part checked against what it replaced.
scenes.say: So: splat pipelines die at the seams. Spirula is one stack, each part checked against what it replaced.

recap: Decoders, SAM 3 and SfM, all rewritten on Vulkan
Two fisheye lenses solved as one rig
fp64 bundle adjustment, so every run repeats
scenes.say: To recap: one Vulkan stack, a 360 camera solved as a rig, and fp64 so every run repeats.
